## Context / Problem

The typed reconciler payload work (earthborn-statuelike-boutu) introduces a named direction/action payload union threaded through the planner, coordinator, and adapter-projection seam. The modules that build/project those payloads are already within a handful of lines of the hard 800-LOC module-size cap (`.github/module-size-limit.txt` = 800), so that expand would breach the CI module-size gate on first edit:

- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/run_differs.py` = 798
- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/outbound_differ.py` = 793
- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/applier.py` = 793

Create headroom FIRST as a behavior-preserving extraction along existing call-graph seams, so the typed cutover lands without fighting the module-size gate. This story adds no typed-payload logic; it only relocates existing clusters.

## Approach

Extract cohesive, already-clustered helpers into sibling modules (existing call-graph seams only; target 200-500 LOC; never create a module < 100 LOC; never split mechanically):

- `run_differs.py`: move the outbound sub-pass (`_run_differs_outbound` + its alert emitters `_emit_outbound_field_alerts` / `_emit_recovery_failure_alerts`) into a sibling module.
- `outbound_differ.py`: move the memoized effective-mapping resolvers (`_memoize_effective`, `_effective_status_map_for`, `_effective_type_map_for`, `_effective_priority_map_for`, `_effective_create_defaults_for`, `_effective_link_map_for`, `_effective_excluded_sync_types_for`) into a sibling module.
- `applier.py`: DEFAULT to the cross-project/drift cluster (`HeadDriftError`, `CrossProjectTargetError`, `_cross_project_targets`, `_recheck_drift`, PLUS the module-level `_JIRA_KEY_RE` regex that `_cross_project_targets` depends on — it moves with the cluster so no back-edge into `applier.py` is needed) — fully self-contained, yields ~793->~723 LOC (comfortably below 800; short of the AC1 700 target, which is a SOFT aim here, not a hard bar — 723 is acceptable given the batch-cluster fallback below is circular-import-prone). Fall back to the batch-execution cluster (`_apply_batch`, `_apply_one`, `_print_batch_recon`) only if that headroom proves insufficient; that cluster instead calls back into applier.py-resident symbols, so choosing it requires re-exporting those back-references too.

**Re-export requirement (load-bearing):** every symbol relocated out of `applier.py` or `run_differs.py` MUST be re-exported back into the ORIGINAL module via a top-level `from <sibling> import <name>  # noqa: F401` (mirroring the pattern already used repeatedly in both files, e.g. `outbound_differ.py`'s `outbound_assignee`/`outbound_comments`/`outbound_labels`/`outbound_links` splits and `applier.py`'s own `apply_base`/`apply_handlers`/`apply_outbound`/`batch_dispatch`/`pass_io`/`rebar_id_audit`/`typed_dispatch` splits). The resident internal caller must keep resolving the symbol via the ORIGINAL module's own globals (a bare-name reference, not a qualified `sibling.name()` call) so it binds to whatever is currently in that module's namespace at call time. Required because:

- Multiple unit tests patch/reference the to-be-moved symbols through the ORIGINAL module namespace by attribute name (found via string-name grep, not LSP structural refs): `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/mutate/test_apply_batch_drift_tolerance.py` (`pytest.raises(applier.HeadDriftError)`, `applier._apply_batch(...)`); `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conflict/test_conflict_filing_deferred.py` (`monkeypatch.setattr(applier, "_apply_batch", ...)`); `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_applier_cross_project_guard.py` (`pytest.raises(applier_mod.CrossProjectTargetError)`); `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_live_mode_failure_tally.py` (`monkeypatch.setattr(applier, "_recheck_drift", ...)`); and three `run_differs`-module fixtures (`diffing/test_snapshot_differ_stale_local_state.py`, `state/test_run_differs_wires_refresh_scoped_snapshot_79a4.py`, `orchestrate/test_ticket_plan_shadow.py`) all doing `monkeypatch.setattr(run_differs_mod, "_run_differs_outbound", ...)`.
- A production in-package consumer also reads a relocated symbol off the ORIGINAL module by attribute: `batch_dispatch.py` does `applier.HeadDriftError` via its own `lazy_load("rebar_reconciler.applier", "applier.py")`. `HeadDriftError` MUST remain resolvable as `applier.HeadDriftError` after relocation.
- `outbound_mutation_builders.py` imports the five `_effective_*_for` resolvers from `outbound_differ` directly — unaffected by the re-export (still imports from `outbound_differ`, which itself re-exports from the new sibling); named here for inventory completeness.
- Additional original-namespace consumers, all edit-free via the re-export: `tests/integration/test_reconcile_live_e2e.py` (`run_differs._emit_outbound_field_alerts`); `test_live_mode_failure_tally.py` (`applier.CrossProjectTargetError`, `applier._recheck_drift`); `test_applier_drift.py` (`applier.HeadDriftError`, `applier._drift_is_benign`); `test_applier_cross_project_guard.py` (`applier_mod._cross_project_targets`); `test_outbound_multi_project.py`, `test_run_differs_recovery_no_write.py`, `test_parent_drop_parity_8390.py`, `test_parent_emit_suppression_is_loud_9f26.py`, `test_outbound_field_conflict_and_drop_alerts.py` (`run_differs._emit_outbound_field_alerts` / `_run_differs_outbound` direct calls or fixtures); `test_status_mapping.py`, `test_link_mapping.py` (`outbound_differ._effective_status_map_for` / `_effective_link_map_for`). Scope includes `tests/integration/test_reconcile_live_e2e.py` alongside the unit suites.

Public entry points and import paths keep working via this re-export; only the IMPLEMENTATION moves, not the original module's namespace resolution.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/` — extract named clusters into new sibling modules; re-export each relocated symbol back into its original module (top-level import); update imports only elsewhere.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/` and `tests/integration/test_reconcile_live_e2e.py` — import-path updates only; no assertion changes. Tests patching the ORIGINAL module namespace (enumerated above) need NO changes — the re-export keeps them resolving.

## Testing

Existing reconciler unit/integration suites pass unchanged, including every string-keyed monkeypatch/patch.object/pytest.raises site enumerated above. Module-size gate + complexity ratchet pass. Lint + typecheck pass. No new CI-provider/network/Docker/Jira dependency.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `run_differs.py`, `outbound_differ.py`, and `applier.py` are each comfortably below 800 LOC (target <= 700), achieved only by extracting existing call-graph clusters into sibling modules.
- [x] No newly created module is below 100 LOC, and no extraction is mechanical.
- [x] Every relocated symbol is re-exported back into its original module via a top-level import, and every internal caller in that module resolves it via a bare/module-namespace reference — so `applier.HeadDriftError`/`CrossProjectTargetError`/`_apply_batch` (if chosen)/`_cross_project_targets`/`_recheck_drift`, `run_differs._run_differs_outbound`/`_emit_outbound_field_alerts`/`_emit_recovery_failure_alerts`, and `outbound_differ._effective_status_map_for` (+ siblings)/`_memoize_effective` all keep resolving, and every enumerated monkeypatch/pytest.raises site continues to work with zero assertion changes.
- [x] `batch_dispatch.py`'s `applier.HeadDriftError` attribute read keeps resolving after the applier.py extraction.
- [x] Behavior is unchanged: existing reconciler test suites pass with no edits beyond import paths.
- [x] Module-size gate, per-function complexity ratchet, lint, and typecheck all pass.
- [x] No production write-route change and no typed-payload/union logic is introduced here; that remains earthborn-statuelike-boutu.
